entry.title: New: Resolution 498 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Council: Adopts Res. 498-26 & GOEAC-115 - 04/22/26
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN INTERGOVERNMENTAL AGREEMENT WITH THE STATE OF HAWAIʻI, OFFICE OF PLANNING AND SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT, TO RECEIVE A GRANT FOR THE 34 RAINBOW DRIVE AFFORDABLE HOUSING PROPOSAL TO BE USED BY THE OFFICE OF HOUSING AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT

Allows for the receipt of $1,000,000 in federally derived funds to be used for the planning and engineering design for roadways and utility improvements to interior areas.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 498-26 & GOEAC-115 - 04/22/26
